name: jacobvm04/slam-dunk
title: SLAM Dunk open-sources long-horizon egocentric tracking
summary: SLAM Dunk models drifting camera calibration and gyroscope error, cutting average trajectory error by 58% versus its baseline. It beats Meta Aria SLAM on 3 of 5 LaMAria categories, ranks first on the UZH-FPV drone benchmark at submission with 0.457% translation error, and the code is public.

appearances.title: SLAM Dunk open-sources long-horizon egocentric visual-inertial SLAM
appearances.summary: SLAM Dunk is an open-source visual-inertial pipeline that models camera calibration drift and gyroscope error instead of assuming the sensors stay fixed. It cuts average trajectory error by 58% versus its baseline, beats Meta's Aria SLAM in 3 of 5 LaMAria categories while scoring slightly lower overall, and ranked first on the UZH-FPV drone benchmark at submission with 0.457% translation error.
